title: Route auth PRs to the right reviewer
description: Use when opening or reviewing a pull request that touches src/auth/**. Routes the review to an active auth maintainer.

pr_url.description: URL of the pull request being opened

touched_paths.description: Repo-relative paths changed by the PR

reviewer.description: GitHub login to request review from

preconditions: PR touches one or more files under src/auth/**
safety_checks: Chosen reviewer is an active maintainer (a commit in the last 90 days)
Never auto-assign the PR author as their own reviewer
